content:
Hello wonderful Leanists! We're organising a one-day in-person session on Novel Formalisations of Mathematics in Lean on Thursday, 25 July 2024. This will be part of the International Congress of Mathematical Software 2024 conference taking place in Durham University from Monday, 22 July 2024 to Thursday, 25 July 2024. Please see this link for details on registration.
﻿
This is a very short notice, but we encourage everyone (even if you're a beginner!) who has done recent work in the formalisation of mathematics in Lean to come give a short 20-minute talk. If you feel like "I've done something in Lean and I wanna spend 20 minutes telling others about it", we highly encourage you to apply! Come and be a part of a prestigious international conference, where you can meet fellow Lean users and possible future collaborators!
﻿
If you're interested, please send one of us (Amelia Livingston: ucahali@ucl.ac.uk, David Ang: ucahdka@ucl.ac.uk, Li Fangming: fangming.li17@imperial.ac.uk, Zhang Jujian: jujian.zhang19@imperial.ac.uk) a title and abstract by Saturday, 30 March 2024 (just a preliminary one; you can modify them later), and we'll be in touch. We'll inform you of your acceptance by the following day, in which case you're invited to submit a 5-page extended abstract by 5 April (just a preliminary one; you can modify them up to 3 May).
The website has been updated! This page now has the correct title, and includes a list of talks by various speakers.
